build_BaseSelfSupervisor: build a self-supervised learning model with backbone, neck, head, and target generator modules
run_forward_tensor_mode: run the forward pass in tensor mode to extract feature tensors from input data
run_forward_loss_mode: run the forward pass in loss mode to compute and return a dictionary of loss values
extract_feat_backbone: extract features from input tensor by forwarding through the backbone network module
review_loss_abstractmethod: review the abstract loss method that subclasses must implement to calculate loss from inputs
